workflows.name: Employee Engagement Survey, Pulse & Sentiment Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "HR Analytics deploys survey across all locations" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-483 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Voice, Engagement & Partnership Management (PA-84.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Engagement risk**: Low participation / no action erodes trust; mitigated by anonymity and visible follow-through
System Touchpoints: - Survey platform; sentiment analytics; action-plan tracker

steps.activity: HR Analytics designs engagement survey and quarterly pulse; ensures anonymity and Data Privacy Act compliance
HR Analytics deploys survey across all locations (mobile/kiosk for non-desk workers); tracks participation; analyzes results by segment
LR Director/Communications shares results with management and LMC; co-designs action plans with employees/union; tracks improvement
